name: noahkiss/genealogy-mcp
content:
# genealogy-mcp

A Model Context Protocol server for interactive genealogy research across multiple tree providers.

**Status**: Early design / pre-alpha.

## Why

Existing CLI tools like [`getmyancestors`](https://github.com/Linekio/getmyancestors) work great for batch GEDCOM exports, but they have two limitations:

1. **No interactivity** — you kick off a multi-hour pull and pray it doesn't crash. No way to ask "who are this person's siblings?" or "what does FS know about a Hans Eby born 1685 in the Pfalz?" without writing a new script.
2. **Single provider** — only FamilySearch. If your tree is partially in Gramps and partially in FS, you're stuck swivel-chairing between them.

`genealogy-mcp` exposes interactive lookup, walk, search, and (gated) write tools to any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, ada/Matrix bots, etc.), backed by a shared sqlite cache so repeated queries are free, and pluggable across providers via a small `Provider` interface.

## Providers

| Provider | Read | Search | Write | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FamilySearch | planned (v0) | planned | gated | OAuth2 password grant; bulk-fetch endpoint |
| Gramps Web | planned (v0.2) | planned | gated | REST + JWT; self-hosted |
| WikiTree | planned (v0.3) | planned | n/a (read-only) | Public, no auth |
| Ancestry.com | not viable | — | — | API discontinued 2018 |

## Tool surface (parameterized by `provider`)

```
lookup(provider, id)                        → Person + relationships (cached)
walk(provider, id, direction, steps, …)     → Graph slice (resumable via job_id)
search(provider, name=, place=, …)          → Ranked candidates
lateral(provider, id, generations)          → Siblings, nieces, cousins
match_candidates(provider, id)              → Provider-side dup detection
export_gedcom(provider, ids, ascend, descend, out)

cache_stats() / cache_invalidate(ids) / cache_export(out)

# Gated (hook-blocked, dry-run default):
upsert_person(provider, person, dedupe=True)
attach_source(provider, id, source)
link_parent_child(provider, child_id, father_id?, mother_id?)
create_couple(provider, person1_id, person2_id, marriage_facts?)
import_gedcom(provider, ged_path, dry_run=True)
```

IDs are namespaced: `fs:LK93-9PS`, `gramps:I0001`, `wikitree:Eby-12345`. A single sqlite cache stores all providers; an `xref` table maps equivalent persons across providers.

## Architecture

See [`docs/design.md`](docs/design.md).

## Status

This repo was bootstrapped 2026-05-02 from notes accumulated during a Lancaster Co. PA Mennonite genealogy research project. v0 work has not started; the current pri is documenting the design and getting one provider (FS) end-to-end before adding others.
